## Summary

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and linked issue.

## Validation

List the commands and outcomes. Identify pre-existing failures or external blockers.

## Compatibility

Describe changes to MQTT topics/payloads, retention, configuration, deployment or documentation. Include migration guidance and a changeset when required.

- [ ] Relevant checks passed or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Documentation and license notices are accurate.
- [ ] No credentials, sessions or private device data are included.
